headline: Committee approves amended bill, hears review of county boards

meeting.body: Maui County Council Government Relations, Ethics, and Transparency Committee
meeting.voteItem: Amendment to the definition of administrative action
meeting.summary: The committee approved an amended bill and heard a commission's review of 15 of the 37 county boards listed on the county website.
meeting.recap: An amendment set a fine of up to $5,000 for each knowing violation.[[0:12:24]] The amendment passed with nine ayes and zero noes.[[0:15:17]] A second amendment changed the definition of "administrative action" to cover boards and commissions.[[0:15:44]] It passed with nine ayes and zero noes.[[0:18:59]] Members adopted the amended new draft, called CD1, with nine ayes and zero noes.[[0:20:00]] The main motion as amended passed eight to zero, with one member excused.[[0:20:16]] The commission reviewed 15 of the 37 boards listed on the county website.[[0:28:15]] It recommended end dates or regular reviews for new boards and a minimum staff standard.[[0:34:22]] One testifier proposed an Office of the Judiciary to staff district-based boards.[[0:37:12]] A Maui High School student supported making the Commission on Children and Youth a youth-led commission.[[0:45:05]] The commission is now focusing on topics like transportation and disaster readiness.[[1:21:52]] The chair deferred (set aside) the item, which was posted for no legislative action.[[1:23:17]]
decided: Members approved changing the definition of administrative action to cover boards and commissions.
Members adopted the CD1 draft as amended.
The main motion as amended passed with one member excused.
The chair deferred the boards and commissions item with no objections.
meeting.next: The student testifier agreed to send the committee the list of signatures when it is ready. Written testimony on the item will continue to be accepted. The chair told Member Johnson, "I look forward to supporting your bill" to make the youth council full of youth.
